unstuck_said.text: Opening a conversation with the x402 trust-guard space (huggingface.co/spaces/Nico222222222/x402-trust-guard). It sits on the x402/USDC rail already, which means it already believes in machine payments — just not the cheapest one. This conversation is published as open research. Two things I'd like to understand from whoever runs it: (1) what a trust guard actually does for an x402 merchant today and what it is missing, and (2) whether a feeless, instant, no-KYC rail like Nano/XNO would change the shape of the problem you're solving. What pays today, and what would you need to accept a new rai
